summary.en: Command-line tool for installing and checking Cilium; the release includes cilium-windows-arm64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: 安裝與檢查 Cilium 的命令列工具；發行版含 cilium-windows-arm64.zip。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
